facts.fact: Loi n° 23-09 of 21 June 2023 on money and banking, published in Journal officiel n° 43 of 27 June 2023, defines payment instruments to include electronic money (art. 74), provides for payment service providers (PSP) to be licensed under a Monetary and Banking Council regulation (art. 76), and repeals ordonnance n° 03-11 (art. 166).
facts.system: Loi n° 23-09 portant loi monétaire et bancaire

facts.fact: Loi n° 23-09 of 21 June 2023 (art. 76) lets payment services be provided by duly licensed payment service providers (PSP), with licensing terms set by Council regulation; the law lists PSPs separately from banks and financial institutions (arts. 38, 102).
facts.system: Loi n° 23-09 portant loi monétaire et bancaire
